shots.action_description: On a vineyard road at sunrise, the driver stands beside a dusty champagne-colored sedan, draws one finger through the dust on the hood and studies it like the rim of a wine glass. A hot-air balloon drifts over the hills behind.
shots.visual_prompt: wide shot of a two-lane country road between rows of grapevines on rolling golden hills at sunrise, a dusty champagne-colored sedan parked on the road, the driver standing beside it inspecting a fingertip of dust from the hood, a hot-air balloon in the hazy morning sky, oak trees, nobody inside the car, plain blank license plate
shots.voiceover_line: Temecula Valley. Dozens of wineries. Balloons at sunrise. And on every fender, a fine layer of vineyard dust.

shots.action_description: In the wash bay, the Wash Sommelier swirls a wine glass filled with pink car-wash foam, holds it up to the light, and nods gravely.
shots.visual_prompt: close up of a car wash attendant styled as a sommelier swirling a wine glass filled with thick pink and white car-wash foam, holding it up to the light with a grave expression, car wash brushes softly out of focus behind
shots.voiceover_line: Three vintages. The House Rinse. The Reserve Triple Foam. And, for the connoisseur, the Grand Cru Ceramic.

shots.action_description: At the tunnel exit, the Wash Sommelier finishes the now gleaming sedan with a folded white hand towel while the driver looks on, approving, as if tasting a fine wine.
shots.visual_prompt: wide shot of a car wash tunnel exit bay, a gleaming freshly washed champagne-colored sedan with nobody inside, on the right the car wash attendant in a black vest, burgundy tie and blue gloves dries the driver's door with a folded white hand towel, on the left the driver in a straw sun hat and cream linen shirt stands back with empty hands, watching approvingly, chrome arch and tall foam brushes behind, warm sun spilling in
shots.voiceover_line: Finished by hand. Now pouring in the Temecula Valley. Book your Reserve Triple Foam this weekend.
